notes:
Opportunity summary: RelayStack runs a multi-tenant cloud contact-center platform for enterprise retailers. Primary objective: aggressive chat deflection to drive down per-ticket AHT and avoid FTE hires for seasonal spikes.

Key numbers / constraints: ~4M inbound customer messages/month, estimated 600M-800M tokens/month depending on prompt amplification; peak concurrency events during promotions with 8-12k concurrent chats; target automated resolution (deflection) >= 60% of front-line chats. Cost sensitivity: looking for unit economics that enable <$0.15 cost per resolved chat (goal), otherwise will keep higher-touch human routing.

Technical asks / preferences: prefer VPC/private deployment or dedicated GPU pools; must support SSO/SAML and KMS; retention/audit logs required for 90 days. Important: predictable token billing during spikes and per-route cost visibility. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/caching, quant quantization profiles).

Engineering details from SE call: RelayStack is very focused on batching/caching and quantization to hit unit economics. They asked about: continuous batching across many short messages, prefix/KV cache reuse for agent-assist sessions, automatic shard selection for peak traffic, and whether Redwood supports int8/4 quant variants and fallbacks. Also asked about model variants for cheap fallback (quantized re-ranked responses) + streaming to reduce perceived latency.

POC plan (2 weeks): deliver a dedicated pool sized for a 4k concurrent baseline with 2x burst for promos; run synthetic replay of historical weekend spike; test deflection flows (FAQ + account lookup via tool-calls) and measure: deflection ratio, avg tokens/chat, p95 latency, cost per resolved chat. Success criteria: demonstrate >=50% deflection in POC, p95 latency <=250ms for agent-assist paths, and modeled monthly cost < target ARR bucket.

Sales/contract notes: AE proposed committed reserved capacity with burst credits; pricing cap request from customer for first 3 months. Security team asked for drive:/RelayStack/security_faq_v1.md and SOC2 artifacts.

Quotes / verbatim: "We can double traffic overnight during promos — if costs spike we lose money on each order. Need predictable per-ticket cost, not surprises." — Head of Ops.

Integration notes / blockers: Genesys routing adapter needs mapping for tool-calls (ticket lookup) and custom webhook authentication. SOC2 log retention gap needs clarification. AE has escalated to product for quantized model roadmap.

Next steps (detailed): finalize POC SOW by 2025-01-20, deliver dedicated pool sizing options, share Optimize recommendations and estimated unit costs using 3 quant profiles, schedule infra deep-dive with security and platform (Marcus + Redwood infra lead).
